content.text: -    Admin: daily    -    titrate slow    -    onset 2wk, 2-3M full effect
-    SE: agitation/irritability/anxiety    -    sedation OR insomnia    -    HA    -    GI    -    ED    -    sweating    -    abnormal bleeding/hyponatremia
-    Duration: t½: 1-3 d acute, 4-6 d chronic    -    norfluoxetine (active metabolite) 4-16 d    -    racemic 50/50 R/S
-    Duration: t½: ~21 h    -    potent selective 5HT reuptake (weak NE/DA)
-    Duration: t½: ~26 h    -    selective 5HT reuptake (weak NE/DA)
-    Monitoring: QT: d/c if persistent QTc >500 ms (dose-dep prolongation)
-    Duration: t½: 27-32 h    -    S-enantiomer (single isomer) of racemic citalopram    -    ~30x more potent than R-enantiomer (human SERT binding)
MDD start 20 mg qAM; panic start 10 mg x1 wk -> 20 mg/day
OCD 20-60 mg/day rec (up to 80 tolerated); bulimia 60 mg qAM
MDD start 20 mg; Elderly/severe renal/severe hepatic: start 10 mg
max 50; OCD max 60; start 10 mg, max 40 mg/day
GAD/PTSD trials ↓10 mg/day q wk, then 1 wk at 20 mg b4 d/c
gradual rec; elderly/hepatic: titrate slowly from 100 mg
MDD/OCD/PD/PTSD/SAD start 25-50 mg qday; PMDD: 50 mg/day start (cont or luteal-only)
cont: +50 mg/cycle up to 150; intermittent: up to 100 mg/day (50 mg x3 d -> 100 mg)
max 40 qday (interval ≥1 wk); >40 mg ⍉ rec (QT risk); elderly/hepatic/CYP2C19 PM max 20
max 20 qday (interval ≥1 wk); elderly/hepatic 10 mg qday

Note: SSRIs + venlafaxine relative potency = mg ≈ fluoxetine 40 mg/day (Hayasaka 2015; *citalopram = clinical SSRI eq)    -    other SNRIs have ⍉ RCT fluoxetine-eq -> shown by SERT:NET selectivity (5HT-pref -> NE-pref):    -    venlafaxine ~30:1 (most serotonergic) > desvenlafaxine > duloxetine ~10:1 > milnacipran ~2:1 NE > levomilnacipran (most NE-selective; 17× venlafaxine, 27× duloxetine at NET)
